name: Project lessons review
summary: When a phase or a project ends, the project manager gets one blameless review: whether it achieved what it was for, how scope, schedule and budget moved and why, whether the success measures were the right ones, and practice changes for the team to choose, each with an owner and a follow-up date.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for the review: the budget and the tracing of every scope, schedule and cost movement to a recorded change, split into approved, recorded without approval and untraced; fixed exports with default headings and a stop on any that does not match; the marks and verdict rules; the follow-up of changes chosen at the last review; the blameless rules; and the rule that the project manager and delivery leads choose every change, with no owner or date invented.

sources.contribution: Looking back through four lenses (purpose achieved, delivery against plan, soundness of the measures, what to do another way); weighing each measure on available data, response to the work, fit with the purpose and a miss level fixed in advance; deferring the results judgement while still reviewing delivery; a mark for each measure and one overall verdict that allows for results not yet in (the rules for assigning them are Fully Powered AI's own); attention to what worked as well as to problems; lessons turned into concrete, checkable steps; an owner and a date for each follow-on action.
